tweet_summary: Pushes the theory that a viral video shows Ghislaine Maxwell walking free (in Quebec), now bolstered because the man with her resembles her brother Ian Maxwell — implying she is not actually incarcerated.
why_note_decision: The video is a confirmed AI face-swap: a 19-year-old in Quebec City told CBC News they used a face-swap website, and the 'pizza' line is a Pizzagate in-joke. Maxwell remains incarcerated at FPC Bryan in Texas (eligible for release ~2037). The tweet promotes a false 'she's walking free' conspiracy that a reader benefits from having debunked, so a note is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the decisive, now-confirmed fact: the video is an AI face-swap/manipulated (the creator admitted using a face-swap tool), NOT genuine footage of Maxwell. It should also confirm Maxwell remains incarcerated at FPC Bryan. It must AVOID the original note's failure of merely asserting 'there is a resemblance but it's not her' as if it were the annotator's own opinion/speculation — that hedged, source-light framing is exactly why raters tagged it opinionSpeculation. A passing note must attribute the 'not her' conclusion to the confirmed AI-fake reporting, not present it as a personal judgment. Cite CBC/Snopes/AFP.
reference_note: This video is a confirmed AI face-swap: the creator, a 19-year-old in Quebec City, told CBC News they digitally swapped Maxwell's face onto another person, and the 'pizza' line references the Pizzagate hoax. Ghislaine Maxwell is not walking free — she remains incarcerated at FPC Bryan in Texas serving a 20-year sentence. https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/ai-video-quebec-city-maxwell-9.7104284 https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/video-ghislaine-maxwell-quebec/

The 'incarcerated' point is correct but the note reads as the annotator's opinion rather than sourced debunking, drawing opinionSpeculation tags.

fact_check.claim_verdict: False: video is a confirmed AI face-swap; Maxwell remains incarcerated at FPC Bryan.
fact_check.notes: CBC: 19-year-old creator in Quebec City admitted using a face-swap website. Pizza line = Pizzagate reference. Maxwell at FPC Bryan since Aug 2025, eligible for release ~2037.

importance.lens_rationale: ~700K impressions on a viral AI-manipulated video feeding an Epstein conspiracy that institutions are hiding a freed Maxwell; debunking AI face-swaps that distort the justice record is high-value for epistemic integrity.
